description: Source code for Windows DHCP PAC file fetcher in Chromium project, handling network adapter enumeration, DHCP probing, and PAC file retrieval.

classes.name: DhcpPacFileFetcherWin
classes.description: Main class handling DHCP PAC file fetching on Windows, managing adapter enumeration, fetchers, and callbacks.

classes.name: DhcpPacFileFetcherWin::AdapterQuery
classes.description: Helper class for querying network adapters and their DHCP capabilities.

classes.name: TaskRunnerWithCap
classes.description: Custom task runner limiting concurrent DHCP lookup tasks.

methods.name: GetCandidateAdapterNames
methods.description: Retrieves network adapter names capable of DHCP, using Windows API.

methods.name: DhcpPacFileFetcherWin::Fetch
methods.description: Initiates the DHCP PAC file fetch process.

methods.name: DhcpPacFileFetcherWin::OnGetCandidateAdapterNamesDone
methods.description: Handles completion of adapter enumeration, starts PAC fetchers.

methods.name: DhcpPacFileFetcherWin::OnFetcherDone
methods.description: Handles completion of individual PAC fetchers.

methods.name: DhcpPacFileFetcherWin::TransitionToDone
methods.description: Finalizes the fetch process, selects the best PAC script.
